title: ジャパンCの後に・重なり合う源流

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black finishes the Japan Cup. The fans go wild and chant her name enthusiastically.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the next race will be the long-awaited Arima Kinen, where Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond will once more be reunited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Kitasan Black plowing forward and leading by example, and Satono Diamond following in her tracks, the two have managed to reach the destination they've long dreamed of.
